Strategy: Add a penalty just above the winning wide band, punishing leftovers between fifty-one and sixty while rewarding twenty-five to fifty. It may help by sharpening the upper edge, but may fail if the penalty hits bins that are actually useful.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 51 and r - item <= 60 else 0) for r in bins]
```
